_comment: Allowlist of docker-compose services that have NO corresponding chart Deployment/StatefulSet/Job/DaemonSet — by design.

test-only._comment: Compose-only test artifacts; never deployed to K8s.

cluster-prereq._comment: Cluster-scoped operator / addon prerequisites. Operator installs out-of-band (see charts/openwhispr/examples/*.sh).

bundled-ai-conditional._comment: Chart renders only when bundledAi.enabled=true; OFF in values-ci.yaml (T-09-08).

load-test-only._comment: docker-compose.load-test.yml horizontal-scale-out artifacts; production scale-out happens via HPA + Pooler CRD instead.
